filaments.name: PLA
filaments.food_safe: No; printed parts are generally not food-safe without certified material and process.
filaments.notes: Easiest general-purpose material; good default for lithophanes.

filaments.name: PLA+ / tough PLA

filaments.name: Silk PLA

filaments.name: Matte PLA

filaments.name: PETG
filaments.outdoor: Better moisture resistance than PLA, but UV can degrade it
filaments.notes: Tough and chemical-resistant; can string more than PLA.

filaments.name: TPU 95A
filaments.notes: Flexible material; print slowly, minimize retraction, and use a direct-drive extruder where possible.

filaments.name: ABS
filaments.fumes: Significant; use ventilation and do not breathe fumes.
filaments.notes: Warp-prone; requires enclosure, controlled cooling, and ventilation.
filaments.calibration: Temperature, flow, retraction, pressure advance, and speeds need calibration for the specific printer and filament.

filaments.name: ASA
filaments.fumes: Significant; use ventilation and appropriate PPE.
filaments.notes: Outdoor-capable engineering material; warp-prone and requires ventilation.
filaments.calibration: Temperature, flow, retraction, pressure advance, and speeds need calibration for the specific printer and filament.

filaments.name: Polycarbonate (PC)
filaments.nozzle: hardened steel recommended for some blends
filaments.outdoor: Good mechanical performance; check UV stabilization
filaments.notes: High-temperature, strong material; very hygroscopic and demanding to print.

filaments.name: Nylon / PA
filaments.notes: Extremely hygroscopic; dry before printing and keep dry during use.

filaments.name: CF-PLA
filaments.nozzle: hardened steel required or strongly recommended
filaments.fumes: Low to moderate; ventilate; carbon-fiber particles require care.

filaments.name: CF-PETG
filaments.nozzle: hardened steel required or strongly recommended
filaments.outdoor: Better than PLA but check UV stability
filaments.fumes: Low to moderate; ventilate; carbon-fiber particles require care.

filaments.name: Wood-filled PLA
filaments.nozzle: 0.5 mm or larger recommended; hardened nozzle if abrasive
